catalog.name: Nob Hill Loop
catalog.description: A single block circuit with two signalised corners. The gentlest way in.

catalog.name: California Arterial
catalog.description: The long way round on the two arterials, at 35 mph with cross traffic.

catalog.name: Signal Ladder
catalog.description: North-west block: every corner is signalised, so the light cycle drives.

catalog.name: Hyde Street Merge
catalog.description: The tight block with heavy traffic — lead vehicles cut in without warning.

catalog.name: Outer Circuit
catalog.description: The full perimeter. Long straights, four-way stops at the quiet corners.
